question: Where does the ground-click world position actually come from, given the intersection contract yields only a distance?

findings.intersection: WidgetGroundTargetContracts.MainPath2DDC0 / WorldIntersectionContracts.GetIntersection220840 produce Distance00 (and material in the floor path) but leave WorldIntersectionObserved44.Position08 Unknown. Confirmed by assertion (docs/reverse-client/r1-ground-hit-fixture-20261105.json).
findings.camera_target: CameraTargetContracts.GetTarget(state, output, boundaries, i) reads state.Target120 (the camera inline target) and rewrites it into output at 0x2BE6F8..; it does NOT take a ray or a distance.
findings.shared_primitive: CameraTargetBoundaries.GetRegion6094A0 is Engine22C0B0, the same Q0 region-token load that PlayerMoveRequestContracts.MoveIdle165CB0 performs on its position argument. Both halves therefore read the region token the same way, which is the natural join.

implication: The ground position is not produced by the intersection; it lives in CameraTargetState.Target120 and is transformed by GetTarget. Whoever writes Target120 (the pick path or the camera update) is the missing producer, and it is not established here.

what_would_be_needed.write_site: the site that stores into CameraTargetState.Target120 after a pick (or the camera update that maintains it)
what_would_be_needed.evidence: a saved body showing that store, which this workspace does not currently identify

not_claimed: that Target120 holds the clicked ground point
that the position handoff to MoveIdle165CB0 works
next: Locate the writer of CameraTargetState.Target120 from saved bodies; if it is the pick path, the bridge can be completed without a camera fixture.

searches: All 72 stores to [reg+0x120] across saved bodies were enumerated; none is in a camera-related evidence file (41 files checked).
The body that contains 0x2BE6F8 only READS the camera inline target: LEA RCX,[RDI+0x120] then CALL [0x6094A0] (GetRegion), then MOVUPS from [RDI+0x120].
static_search_result.conclusion: The writer of CameraTargetState.Target120 is not present in the saved camera evidence, and a global xref search is not available from the saved artifacts.

cheaper_route.idea: Rather than hunting the static writer, read Target120 at runtime immediately after a ground click.
cheaper_route.why: The sampler is already validated (Toolkit/PSAPI/24 logic checks) and a runtime read needs no new reverse engineering.
cheaper_route.prerequisite: the client running in a loaded level, plus the address of the camera object (or of the state that owns +0x120)
cheaper_route.status: not executed; the client is not running
